Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) e 1 Narrative & Plans — 2700-04 North Laramie Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District
Lot Area: 7,137.5 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to convert the three (3) commercial spaces on
the building's first floor into three (3) residential units. The resulting
building will be fully residential and contain seventeen (17) dwelling units
total. The height and footprint of the existing three-story building will
remain without change. The subject property is a Transit Served Location
and will not provide off-street parking. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D
optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-
13-1003-EE of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to
reduce the residential off-street parking ratio from 17.65% (3 parking
spaces) to zero and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by
the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 14,633 square feet (2.05 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 419.86 square feet per D.U.
(17 dwelling units proposed)

© The amount of off-street parking: zero

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location based on its
proximity to the Diversey Bus Route. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the
Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking ratio from 17.65% (3 parking
spaces) to zero.

(@) — Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: zero (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:

South Side: zero (existing)
c. Rear Setback: 2.67 ft. (existing)

(E) Building Height: 28.69 feet
